connectionSpecification.description: Writes each stream into a typed MergeTree table of one database: overwrite, append or append_dedup.

database.description: Database every table is written to; it must exist.
database.title: Database

optimize_final.description: Run OPTIMIZE TABLE ... FINAL on every append_dedup table after the sync, so it holds one row per primary key without FINAL.
optimize_final.title: Optimize after sync

port.description: Port of the server; when unset 9000 (native), 9440 (native with TLS), 8123 (http) or 8443 (http with TLS).
port.title: Port

protocol.description: Native TCP protocol or HTTP interface.
protocol.title: Protocol

tls.description: Encrypts the connection and verifies the server certificate.

ca_certificate.description: PEM certificate of the CA that signed the server certificate; the system roots when unset.
ca_certificate.title: CA certificate

client_certificate.description: PEM client certificate, when the server asks for one.
client_certificate.title: Client certificate

client_key.description: PEM private key of the client certificate.
client_key.title: Client key

tls.title: TLS

connectionSpecification.title: ClickHouse Destination Spec
